trails.name: Kystruten Mors near Thisted

trails.name: Tranum-Fosdal

trails.name: Rebild Bakker Ruten
trails.why: A marvelously beautiful circle through open, warm landscape and ancient forests, the hilly terrain requiring some conditioning, the reward of which is wide views from the hills.

trails.why: Take a walk in your local area - or experience a new place.The Freiluftsråd has created Kløverstien throughout Denmark, where you can walk, run or cycle four different distances from about 2 to 12 km from one point of departure.

trails.name: Køng Mose rundtur

trails.name: Kystruten Mors near Thisted (2)
trails.why: From Kokkedal, the route follows the coastline, which turns westward. At elevated water levels, go up Saltbækvej and down Skibstedvej.

trails.name: The Italian path
trails.why: The Italian Trail is one of several marked hiking trails in the protected part of the Mols Mountains in southern Djursland in East Jutland.

trails.name: Ajstrup Bugt
trails.why: Ajstrup Bay is a protected area, rich in nature and ancient monuments such as ancient deep trenches and steep slopes down to flat coastal areas that are raised seabed from the Stone Age Sea.
